title: The Watchman’s Call
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
High on the wall the watchman stood
And looked out far and wide;
He blew his trumpet loud and clear
So all could run inside.

[Chorus]
"Turn, turn, and live!" the watchman calls,
"Come home, come home today!"
The Lord is glad, so glad to see
His children find the way.

[Verse 2]
The Lord said to Ezekiel,
"My watchman you will be;
Go tell My people they can turn
And come back home to Me."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Some people wandered far away
And chose the wrong way too;
But he did not stay quiet then,
He called out loud and true.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
If I choose wrong, I'll turn around
And say, "I'm sorry," too;
I'll try again and run back home,
The way He wants me to.

[Chorus]
mood: Calling music. A bright, steady walking step under the voice, like a boy standing tall on a wall and cupping his hands to call across a field. A soft ukulele strum keeping the step, an upright bass walking underneath, nothing crowded. Glad and open rather than stern, and each chorus comes back a little warmer, the way a wave from far off gets bigger as you get closer to home.
